description: This file defines functions and types for detecting and probing ZAI endpoints, including constants for URLs, types for endpoint identifiers and detection results, and an async function to probe endpoints with a timeout.

methods.name: probeZaiChatCompletions
methods.description: Probes a ZAI chat completion endpoint with specified parameters, returning success or error details.

methods.name: detectZaiEndpoint
methods.description: Detects an available ZAI endpoint by probing candidate URLs with specified or default parameters.
